name: Over-the-Board Chess — FIDE Game
description: A single classical over-the-board game: a tournament pairing starts a game on a physical board and clock, players make moves and press the clock, the arbiter rules on incidents, and the game concludes by checkmate, resignation, draw agreement, or time forfeit before the result is recorded on the scoresheet.
